description: Registered F-AZSA and flown in Aeronautique navale markings, although the aircraft never served with the Marine and the scheme is not authentic (ARDHAN February 2025).
Registered F-AZVV and painted in the markings of escadrille 11.S although it is not of naval origin (ARDHAN February 2025).
Painted in fictitious 14.F Aeronautique navale colours; ARDHAN notes the Marine never operated the type, so the markings are invented.
Registered F-BFUB and based at Niort-Souche since 2002 in private hands (ARDHAN February 2025).
